notes: 2.6.5 A significant share (69.4%) of cases under ‘Indecent Representation of women’ , 50 percent of
cases under “Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act’ followed by Right Act (35.9%) at the country
level were reported from 23 mega cities only.
Crimes under Arms and Explosives/Explosive Substances Act
2.6.6 The incidence of cases under Arms Act in cities declined by 5.0 per cent during the year. The
23 cities reported around 13.8 per cent of the total cases reported in the country in this year under this
Act. Against the national level crime rate of 6.1, Indore (93.8) reported a very high crime rate
relating to violation of Arms Act. Incidence-wise, more cases were reported from Delhi(2,476),
